propositions: transition_ticket and claim_ticket MCP methods lack write-parameter parity with CLI/lib equivalents, preventing agents from performing operations available through CLI/lib surfaces.
transition_ticket is missing reason, caused_by, and ref parameters; claim_ticket is missing force parameter; both are required to reach compliance.
MCP rejects reason-required ticket closes (e.g., not_a_bug class) because transition_ticket has no reason parameter to supply the required value.

MCP force parameter was intentionally omitted under prior policy, but operator rulings (2026-08-18) rescind this restriction; force is now allowed through all surfaces with auditability via absent-attestation model.
MCP tool docstrings incorrectly assert force is CLI-only and must be updated to reflect the absent-attestation audit model.
